Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Emerick Rustic Stoneware Planter Pot - 6 Inch, Brown and White
Materials: Stone
The natural earth tones in this stoneware planter will match well with any interior design. With or without a plant, this beautiful stoneware pot will add a stylish touch to your office or any room in your home. It can fit nicely on a windowsill or desktop. Exterior: 6.69" Diameter x 6.3"H; Interior: 6.125" Diameter x 5.625"H 100% stoneware For small plants Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth Designed for indoor or artificial plants; no drainage hole
